Analyses performed:
  1. Median II (low-high) + bootstrap 95% CI (B=10000, percentile method)

    ("s015", "s020"),
    ("s020", "s025"),
    ("s025", "s030"),
    ("s015", "s030"),
]

ALPHA = 0.05
N_PERM = 5000

    return f"profiling_output_{prefix}bf16_{model_short}_{masking}_{slabel}"


def load_problems(dirpath: Path) -> Optional[List[dict]]:
    fpath = dirpath / "profiling_results.json"
    if not fpath.exists():
        return None
    with open(fpath) as f:
        data = json.load(f)
    ppi = data.get("per_problem_ii", {})
    keys = list(ppi.keys())
    if not keys:
        return None
    return ppi[keys[0]]

    diffs = []

        va, vb = p.get(f"ii_{pa}"), p.get(f"ii_{pb}")

            diffs.append(va - vb)
    return np.array(diffs)
